teaser.text: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited, known as CATL, makes rechargeable batteries for vehicles and electricity storage. Its business is the sale of engineered hardware, manufacturing capacity and long-term support, with money flowing in from industrial customers and out to suppliers, factories and service obligations.

paragraphs.text: The weighted price is HKD530.71 in October 2027. It implies an 8% total return. By October 2029, the weighted price is HKD677.50. It implies a 40% total return. The bear case carries a 25% probability. The base case carries a 55% probability. The bull case carries a 20% probability.

blocks.heading: What has to go right for CATL, and what could go wrong?

paragraphs.text: EBITDA is the main operating judgment. The base case rises from RMB155,000m to RMB194,000m as vehicle and storage demand support shipments. The bear case runs from RMB125,000m to RMB145,000m because pricing pressure and slow plant ramps hold margins below the current proxy. The bull case runs from RMB168,000m to RMB230,000m, requiring overseas qualification, strong utilization and better manufacturing economics. CATL sold 661 GWh in 2025 at reported utilization of 96.9%, but first-half margins weakened and much of the capacity under construction has not yet become qualified output.

blocks.heading: How much cash does CATL really make?

paragraphs.text: CATL’s operating cash flow in 2025 stood well above attributable profit, helped by working capital released into cash. Capital spending then absorbed part of the proceeds as CATL built capacity. Free cash flow remained strong, but the stock-pay adjustment was distorted by a reversal, so the resulting increase was mechanical rather than a new customer payment.

blocks.heading: What does an investor pay for CATL today?

paragraphs.text: A price-to-earnings ratio compares the share price with the profit attributable to each share. It therefore reaches beyond sales to include production costs, research, depreciation and tax. Yet battery volume does not guarantee equal profit. A kilowatt-hour measures capacity, like a litre of bottled water measures quantity; it does not say how much the seller keeps. CATL’s first-half 2026 EV-battery gross margin was 20.63%, while storage-battery gross margin was 23.96%. Both declined from a year earlier.

dividend.title: CATL dividend: payout, cash cover and yield
dividend.meta_description: CATL’s dividend history, free-cash-flow coverage, forecast drivers and current yield, alongside expansion and cash-conversion risks.
dividend.opening: CATL’s dividends rose each year from 2022 through 2025, and dividends plus buybacks were 39.1% of free cash flow in 2025. Cash covered the shareholder payments in that period, while expansion and working-capital movements can change what remains.
dividend.closing: The full memo also answers how CATL’s battery business works, how it compares with rivals, how management allocates capital, and what risks could affect it.

blocks.heading: How much does CATL pay per share?

paragraphs.text: Dividends rise from RMB3.5 to RMB4.3 per share in the base case, reflecting roughly 10% annual growth from the last paid regular dividend. The bear case holds at RMB3.2 because investment and weaker cash conversion take priority; the bull case reaches RMB5.8 because earnings and cash conversion remain strong. CATL’s dividend rose each year from 2022 through 2025, but its recent cash result included a sizeable working-capital release.

blocks.heading: Does CATL’s cash cover its dividend?

paragraphs.text: Shareholders received more of the cash as the business grew. Dividends and buybacks reached RMB34,354.126 million in 2025, or 39.1% of free cash flow, compared with 15.2% in 2022. In 2026, CATL proposed a special dividend of RMB47.79 per ten shares and approved a RMB20–40 billion buyback for cancellation. Cancellation permanently removes shares, so each remaining share represents a larger fraction of the company. But approval is not completion, and the benefit depends on the purchase price and future earnings.

blocks.heading: What is CATL’s dividend yield against its price?

paragraphs.text: Market value is what shareholders’ shares are worth; enterprise value estimates what the operating business costs after debt and cash are considered. If you buy a house with a mortgage but keep money in the bank, the house’s ownership value is not the same as the cost of the house after adjusting for financing. CATL’s enterprise value is lower because its cash exceeds the relevant debt. But cash reserved for factories, suppliers or research is like money saved for a renovation: it exists, but it is not safely available for dividends.

earnings.title: CATL earnings: guidance and results
earnings.meta_description: CATL's next results are expected on November 24, 2026; guidance centers on battery shipments, swap stations and execution.
earnings.opening: CATL's next results are expected on November 24, 2026. CATL's key watch is whether overseas plants move from trial production to customer-approved repeat shipments.
earnings.closing: The full CATL memo also covers its business, rivals, management and risks.

paragraphs.text: The larger promise is a network of 4,000 integrated charge-and-swap stations across 190 cities by December 2026. Integrated means that one site can both charge vehicles and replace their batteries. CATL also plans passenger-car and heavy-truck stations, including 600 in colder northern regions, while global deliveries of TENER Sodium are scheduled for June 2027.

blocks.heading: Has CATL kept its past promises?

paragraphs.text: CATL has also reported progress on specific promises. In August 2026, it said it had achieved carbon neutrality in core operations, with all twenty battery plants certified, though the broader value chain remains outside that scope. It reported implementing its 2025 shareholder distribution based on half of attributable profit, while a later buyback proposal specifies cancellation.

blocks.heading: How have CATL's revenue and profit changed over the last eight reported periods?

paragraphs.text: Revenue rose 56.9% from the June 2025 quarter, but operating income rose 35.1% and attributable net income rose 36.5%. Diluted earnings per share rose 31.8%, so sales grew faster than profit, and profit grew faster than the earnings belonging to each share.

blocks.heading: What should CATL watchers look for next?

paragraphs.text: The first checkpoint is 31 December 2026, when the swap-network and TENER Sodium commitments meet their deadlines and Spain reaches its original production target. Open stations matter, but compatible vehicles, paid transactions and commercial deliveries matter more.
